description:
Inkpress is a fast, clean multi-feed RSS and Atom reader. Add any blog or news feed and read every entry in one place — no accounts, no tracking, no clutter.

Entries load straight from each feed, cache for offline reading, and render clean and fast.

Features:
- Subscribe to any RSS or Atom feed
- Offline cache so past entries are always readable
- Fast native reading view
- Light and dark mode
- No accounts, no tracking
whatsNew:
Inkpress now starts with a real newsroom instead of a single blog. Fresh installs come subscribed to sixteen curated sources across Canadian, US and UK news plus tech, and every one of them is a normal subscription you can remove.

Removed a feed and want it back? Manage Feeds now has a Suggested list.

Also fixed: articles from sources that stamp their dates with a zone name rather than an offset were sorting to the top of the list no matter how old they were.
